# Sunny Skies Daycare - Lorton, VA

> A warm, nurturing, CDA Certified home-based daycare in Lorton, Virginia, dedicated to infant care, toddler discovery, preschool preparation, and school-age care (Newborn to 15 years).

## Core Information
- Name: Sunny Skies Daycare
- Website: https://www.sunnyskiesydaycarecenter.com/
- Phone: +1 (703) 606-1557
- Email: sunnyskiescare@gmail.com
- Location: Lorton, Fairfax County, Virginia 22079, United States
- Hours: Monday - Friday, 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM
- Age Range: Newborn to 15 Years Old

## Accreditation & Certifications
- CDA (Child Development Associate) Certified Provider
- Pediatric CPR, AED & First Aid Certified
- Virginia State Licensed / Compliant Home Childcare
- Active USDA CACFP & WIC Approved Food Program
- Military Fee Assistance (Child Care Aware / MCCYN) Accepted

## Programs Offered
- Infant & Newborn Loving Care (0–12 Months): Individualized sleep and bottle logs, gentle holding, tummy time, sensory tracking.
- Toddler Exploration (1–3 Years): Montessori-style wooden tangram puzzles, building blocks, fine motor sensory crafts, gentle potty training support.
- Preschool & Kindergarten Readiness (3–5 Years): Alphabet tracing, early phonics, numbers 1–100, calendar and weather forecasting, cutting & painting.
- School-Age & Homework Club (5–15 Years): Supervised before and after-school care, quiet homework tutoring, board games (UNO, chess), constructive toys.
- Wholesome Nutrition: Homemade breakfasts, warm balanced lunches, and fresh daily fruits (bananas, apples, grapes).
- Outdoor Play: Safe, fenced yard with active games, gross motor fun, and neighborhood nature walks.
